author: Clijmart
body:
A weird-shaped map which makes you hungry, sounds perfect, right?



Info:
This map has 2 wool rooms next to/underneath spawn. You can see inside the rooms from spawn, but not get to them.
You can not build above any void, except for the areas between the cobwebs in middle.

Authors:
- Clijmart
- Sam (Ehlf)
- mepii

Links:
Images: http://imgur.com/a/M6DHS
Download + XML: http://www.mediafire.com/file/qek9ebrdxj81db8/Cake_%5BCTW%5D.zip

This is my first CTW ever, hope you like it :D

- Clijmart
